searchText: When will the bug be fixed? "its been fixed and deployed now". It links to the pull request showing that happening. What's the plan for starting a kiln compatible public testnet? <@!717458004143898714> we want to stand up a couple short-lived devnets with client versions who support the latest spec, once that's done and we're confident, we'll have a proper public release that's a bit more polished You are of course welcome to use the devnets, but just be aware there won't be a ton of infra to connect to them + they will be taken down after about a week Thanks will do :) In the meantime, Kintsugi is still live if you want something that'll be up for a couple weeks, has infra support, and don't mind not having the exact latest spec https://kintsugi.themerge.dev/ Hello, Could someone be so kind to give me an example of an `Header` Request in ragards of specs: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/167 i get that the JWT encoded claims are in the Header of the request, but under what field? Authorization? also i would like to point out that `iat` is defined to have to be in range +/- 5 seconds from current time which does not make much sense considering that we cannot have issued it in the future if it is issued in the future that would make no logical sense, i think this may be an error in the spec i think the range should be [now, now+5] instead of [now-5, now+5] Clock skew between the two nodes could mean it's issued in the future. ah okay
